card.name: Environmental and sustainability web text
card.fires_on: Small words and symbols in environment and climate writing, such as 'fewer', 'for', '$', 'protect' or 'and', placed just before an expected term about emissions, sustainability or reducing harm.

modes.label: Words before reduction terms
modes.description: Quantity or action words in pollution and animal-welfare sentences that come right before a harm or reduction idea.

modes.label: Linking words in green-economy names
modes.description: Linking words or punctuation inside organization names or lists about sustainable development and environmental crises.

modes.label: Numbers and amounts for emissions
modes.description: Currency signs or blank spaces just before a figure on climate investment or emissions.

card.writes: It seems to push away words like zero, reduce and reduction, and toward words about blocking or protecting.
card.plain: It fires on small words in environmental and climate articles just before a point about cutting pollution or protecting nature.
